force.title: Cybersecurity & the Breach Economy
force.signature: Every business is now a data target — and the cost of getting breached spawns a whole economy of insurance, forensics, detection, and identity protection.

A \u00b7 Insuring the risk: Cyber risk became a fast-growing, hard-to-price insurance line.
Consumer identity and vetting services scale with breach frequency and fraud.
B \u00b7 Detecting & cleaning up: AI-enabled attacks meet AI-enabled fraud detection and after-the-fact forensics.
Detection, identity, and access software is a structural growth market.
C \u00b7 Guarding the doors: Physical and digital security converge into one spend.
Consultants and IT services monetize the rising security and compliance burden.
E \u00b7 The big picture: Capstone: the cost of insecurity created a whole industry; insurers, security software, and forensics win.
